hero.subheadline: Kyorix builds intelligent technology for sports scoring, competition management and live sporting events. Engineered to deliver sub-millisecond precision, unified bracket progression, and robust tournament infrastructure.

companyMission.label: COMPANY MISSION
companyMission.title: BUILDING THE INFRASTRUCTURE BEHIND COMPETITION.
companyMission.description: Kyorix Sport Technology Private Limited develops technology designed to simplify, connect and modernize competitive sporting events.
companyMission.block1Desc: Real-time competition technology. Engineered for sub-millisecond point registration, referee decision panels, penalty rule tracking, and arena display feeds.
companyMission.block2Desc: Intelligent tournament management. Automated draw generation, seed distribution, BYE calculations, match queuing, and knockout tree synchronization.
companyMission.block3Desc: Connected sporting infrastructure. Unifying participant registration, weigh-in verification, multi-court operations, and certified final results under one architecture.
companyMission.bannerCaption: Built to deliver absolute fairness, speed, and precision in sanctioned tournament environments.

bracketProduct.title: EVERY MATCH. EVERY PATH. CONNECTED.

bracketProduct.imageTitle: KYORIX BRACKET — TOURNAMENT DRAW & PROGRESSION SOFTWARE
bracketProduct.imageSubtitle: Automated category draws, single/double elimination progression, and court assignment

features.description: Mathematical seeding and club/state separation eliminating bias and clerical draw errors.

features.title: Live Multi-Mat Progression
features.description: Instant advancement of victorious athletes to subsequent rounds in real time.

features.title: Cryptographic Bracket Lock
features.description: Immutable draw integrity ensuring zero tampering once tournament brackets are published.

features.title: Official Podium Standings
features.description: Automated computation of Gold, Silver, and Joint Bronze medal allocations.

temsProduct.label: 03 • EVENT MANAGEMENT PLATFORM
temsProduct.title: ONE PLATFORM. THE ENTIRE EVENT.
temsProduct.subtitle: Kyorix TEMS (Taekwondo Event Management System) centralizes the entire competition lifecycle—unifying tournament operations, registration, weigh-in, and results into one operational workspace.

modules.title: Tournament Management
modules.desc: End-to-end configuration for regional, national, and international championships. Manages age categories, weight divisions, mat allocations, and sanctioning body rule sets.

modules.title: Athlete & Coach Registration
modules.desc: Digital entry system for federations, clubs, and individual competitors. Centralizes athlete profiles, coach credentials, and mandatory medical waiver submissions.

modules.title: ID Card & Accreditation Generation
modules.desc: Automated badge and PVC ID card generation engine. Produces scannable credential badges with high-resolution athlete photos, QR codes, and role-based access tiers.
capabilities: Instant batch PDF & PVC printer formatting
Cryptographic QR code for mat-side scanning
Zone access control (Mat, Warm-up, Official, VIP)

modules.title: Digital Weigh-In Certification
modules.desc: Integrated weigh-in terminal system. Connects directly to digital scales to certify athlete weight divisions against sanctioned official tolerances.
capabilities: Automatic division pass / fail threshold alerts

modules.title: Draw Generation & Seeding Engine
modules.desc: Mathematical draw generator enforcing official seeding rules. Automatically isolates competitors from the same club or state to ensure balanced competition trees.
capabilities: Deterministic BYE allocation to top seeds
Cryptographic bracket lock prior to match start

modules.title: Integrated Scoring System Interfacing
modules.desc: Duplex hardware and socket integration with Kyorix Score. Pushes scheduled matches to mat controller terminals and receives verified point tallies in real time.
capabilities: Instant winner advancement to next bracket tier

modules.title: Live Results & Arena Feeds
modules.desc: Synchronous public results distribution. Feeds court displays, spectator web links, livestream graphics overlays, and central tournament command monitors.
capabilities: Broadcast graphics & TV overlay API feeds
Multi-mat court status overview for directors

modules.title: Live Certificates & Podium Records
modules.desc: Automated generation of official podium certificates and tournament awards immediately upon category finalization. Permanent digital record archive for federations.
capabilities: Instant printable certificate generation with QR audit

technologyPreview.label: ENGINEERING ARCHITECTURE
technologyPreview.title: ENGINEERED FOR COMPETITION.
technologyPreview.description: Our architecture is built specifically for the demanding environment of sanctioned sporting tournaments, where data delay or scoring desynchronization is unacceptable.

pillars.title: Sub-Millisecond Telemetry
pillars.desc: Engineered for instantaneous point capture, referee consensus validation and arena scoreboard synchronization with zero perceptual delay.

pillars.title: Distributed Mat Architecture
pillars.desc: Independent court execution engine that continues full scoring operations even during intermittent arena network connectivity.

pillars.title: Audit-Logged Match State
pillars.desc: Every strike registration, penalty award, and referee input is cryptographically timestamped and fully auditable by head officials.

pillars.title: WT Competition Compliance
pillars.desc: Built in strict alignment with World Taekwondo competition rules, scoring gap thresholds, and sanctioned tournament governance.
